stem: How does the author support his claim that every young person has the potential to be a hero?

options.label: F
options.text: By defining the qualities that make a young person a hero

options.label: G
options.text: By providing examples of qualities that have made people famous

options.label: H
options.text: By including examples of young people who exhibit the qualities of a hero

options.label: J
options.text: By contrasting society’s definition of a hero with the word’s real meaning
